text_block_list.text: Frohes neues Jahr! Happy New Year.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Please accept this gift.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Puzzled, I open the box she hands me,
only to be
even more confused.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Sorry, what is this pink ball with eyes?

text_block_list.text:
It's a Glücksschwein—a confection in the
shape of
a pig.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It means "pig of good fortune." Think of
it as a
gift to celebrate the coming year.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
To say this year is the most important
year of my
life is no exaggeration.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
To walk the proper path to success, I
must enter
and win the Classic Triple
Crown races—the
Satsuki Sho, Japanese
Derby, and Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
My desire to complete this difficult
journey and
break through the other
side has been channeled
into this
Glücksschwein.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It is made of marzipan, so you can eat it
once you
are finished displaying it.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Of course. I referenced illustrations to
sculpt it.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Actually, that was what I did for the
beta version
before this one. Allow me
to amend my
statement. Falcon also
contributed to the
creation of this pig.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. For my first version, I collated

photographs to create a
360-degree-view of a
pig to ensure the
most realistic results...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
But Falcon said that a hyperrealistic
marzipan pig
would be terrifying and
advised me to use a cuter
design.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
However, I have almost no experience
with
creating stylized designs...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I tried my best... but I don't think it
turned out all
that well.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: ...I knew it was a pig right away!

text_block_list.text: Really? That's a relief.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I don't have anything to
give
Eishin Flash in return. Just as I'm
trying to think of
what I should do to
thank her...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This is merely a token of my feelings, so
there is
no need to give me anything in
return. But if I had
to ask for something...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I'd like to know if Japan has any New
Year's
customs similar to Glücksschwein
so I can partake
in them for a successful
year.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Pretty much all New Year's traditions are
meant
to bring good luck in the coming
year, but the
most relevant one right
now would be...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Eating New Year's food for health!
Doing calligraphy to declare your resolution!

text_block_list.text:
Flying kites can have a lot of meanings,
but I
explain that flying one high into
the sky
symbolizes wishing for healthy
growth in Japan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Interesting... I'll give it a try right now.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Hmph!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Ah... Look! The kite is rising!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: I will!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I tell her how different New Year's dishes
have
different meanings, and that
people eat them for
good health over
the next year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I had heard of New Year's dishes, but I
didn't
know that about them. Please tell
me more.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I proudly present our signature New
Year's
spread.
text_block_list.name: Traditional Japanese Restaurant Staff

text_block_list.text:
Wow... There are so many small dishes
packed
together.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
What a cute arrangement! Beautiful, I
should say!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I tell her that writing out her true
feelings on
paper will help bolster her
resolution toward
reaching her goals.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So there is a ritualistic aspect to it as
well. In
which case, I shall try my hand at
it with the
utmost sincerity.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: I'm finished.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Please look at the four kanji I wrote.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
They're beautiful! What inspired you to write
these?

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп rendered them from my name.
The first
two is read as "eishin," and the
third and fourth
mean "flash" and
"shine."
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Together, they mean, "an intense light,
suddenly
rising"... The wonderful
imagery left quite an
impression on me.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Trainer. Here's to our

continued cooperation.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Watching her run back and forth with
her eyes on
the kite makes me feel warm
inside.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her eyes are alight with fascination as
she looks
at the food. The dishes seem
to strike a chord
with her, and she
happily listens to the server
explain each
one in detail.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
